links.outcome: Physician-rated hallucination-free and thoroughness of LLM call summaries (1-5 Likert)
links.effect: Hallucination free mean 4.4/5 (SD 0.9) and thorough 4.4/5 (SD 1.0) were the lowest-rated domains; accuracy mean 4.6/5 (SD 0.7); raters penalized inferential hallucinations.
links.quote: The "useful" (mean 4.8/5, SD 0.5) and "consistent" (mean 4.9/5, SD 0.6) domains were the highest rated, and the "thorough" (mean 4.4/5, SD 1.0) and "hallucination free" (mean 4.4/5, SD 0.9) domains were the lowest rated.

unlisted_practices: Adapting the Physician Documentation Quality Instrument to rate LLM summaries of physician-to-physician transfer calls
Assessing transcription accuracy of speech-to-text before LLM summarization

screen.reason: Retrospective feasibility study evaluating speech-to-text (Whisper) and LLM summarization (ChatGPT) of interhospital STEMI transfer calls using physician raters.
